inputs.name: IpcRequestValidator.parse.channel
inputs.description: Channel string used to select the IPC parser. The method throws when the value is absent from `channels`; values beginning with `game:` go to `gamePayload`, while other values go through project-context handling and then `ipcPayload` if that handling returns `undefined`.

inputs.name: IpcRequestValidator.parse.input
inputs.description: Value supplied with the channel for parsing. Its shape is not constrained here and it is passed to `gamePayload`, project-context handling, or `ipcPayload` according to the channel.

outputs.name: IpcRequestValidator.parse
outputs.description: Value returned for the request: the `gamePayload` result for `game:` channels, a defined project-context operation result for other channels, or the `ipcPayload` result. When the `ipcPayload` result is a truthy object, its fields are spread together with project context; the result type is otherwise unconstrained.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with message `Unknown desktop operation.` when `channel` is not among the values in `channels`. Exceptions from delegated parsing or project-context methods are not caught by this method.
